questiontext.text: Which of the following are included in Aristotle's Six Classical Elements of Drama? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Plot, Character, Theme, Diction, Music, and Spectacle are Aristotle's six foundational elements.

name.text: W02_Q18: Cultural and Creative Arts JSS1 Assessment

questiontext.text: Which of the following are recognized stages in Gustav Freytag's dramatic plot pyramid? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Exposition, rising action, climax, falling action, and denouement constitute Freytag's pyramid.

name.text: W02_Q19: Cultural and Creative Arts JSS1 Assessment

questiontext.text: Match each plot stage with its description:

generalfeedback.text: Exposition=introduction; Rising Action=escalation; Climax=peak confrontation; Denouement=resolution.

questiontext.text: Match each theatrical convention with its definition:

generalfeedback.text: Soliloquy=alone on stage; Monologue=speech to others; Aside=whisper to audience; Dramatic Irony=audience knows secret.
